title: Aftercare Engagement and the Days Approved on TRICARE Prime Approvals (Referrals and Authorizations)
content:
When a TRICARE Prime request under **Referrals and Authorizations** is approved to the network provider after the military clinic's response window has passed, aftercare engagement moves the days approved.

## Evidence on file

The individual outpatient behavioral health visits of the patient on the patient's TRICARE Prime claim lines, counted over the last three months and over the last twelve months.

## Clause

1. Where three or more outpatient behavioral health visits of the patient are dated in the last three months, **1 day is taken off**.
2. Where none is dated in the last twelve months, **2 days are added**.
3. Otherwise nothing changes.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Visits in the last 3 months | Visits in the last 12 months | Change to the days approved |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 5 | 1 day taken off |
| 2 | 6 | none |
| 0 | 4 | none |
| 0 | 0 | 2 days added |
